docket_entries.description: MASTER CALENDAR ON JUN-13-2022. ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE ISSUED TO ATTY. HAYK STAMBULTSYAN SET FOR JUN-24-2022 IN DEPARTMENT 206 AT 9:30 AM FOR FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH THE COURT'S ORDER PURSUANT TO THE NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE OF TRIAL AND TRIAL ORDER. NOTICE SENT BY COURT. (206)

MASTER COURT CALENDAR OF JUN-13-2022 ASSIGNED TO COURT TRIAL CALENDAR ON JUN-13-2022 AT 9:30 AM IN DEPT. 303, JUDGE SUZANNE RAMOS BOLANOS. JUNE POYOUROW, ESQ. SPECIALLY APPEARING FOR HAYK STAMBULTSYAN, ESQ., ATTORNEY OF RECORD FOR PLAINTIFF UGH 1 LLC VIA COURTCALL. MICHAEL HEATH, ESQ. APPEARING FOR DEFENDANT ARTHUR CHOW VIA COURTCALL. THE COURT SET AN ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE ISSUED TO ATTY. HAYK STAMBULTSYAN (COUNSEL OF RECORD FOR PLAINTIFF) FOR JUN-24-2022 IN DEPARTMENT 206 AT 9:30 AM TO SHOW CAUSE WHY SANCTIONS, IN THE AMOUNT OF $250.00, SHOULD NOT BE IMPOSED FOR FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH THE COURT'S ORDER PURSUANT TO THE NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE OF TRIAL AND TRIAL ORDER. NOTICE SENT BY COURT. IF SANCTIONS PAID BEFORE THE OSC DATE OR IF THE CASE SETTLES, THEN THE COURT WILL VACATE THE OSC. OTHERWISE COUNSEL TO FILE A DECLARATION AND MAKE AN APPEARANCE AT THE OSC. COUNSEL MAY PAY SANCTIONS VIA E-FILING. THE COURT ASSIGNED THE CASE TO JUDGE BOLANOS FOR COURT TRIAL, TO BE HEARD TOMORROW. PARTIES WERE ORDERED TO CONTACT DEPT. 303 NO LATER THAN 12:00PM TODAY VIA THE E-MAIL ADDRESS PROVIDED AT TRIAL CALL TO COORDINATE TIME AND JUDGE BOLANOS WILL ALSO INFORM PARTIES IF THE TRIAL WILL BE IN PERSON, VIRTUAL OR HYBRID. THE DEPARTMENT'S PHONE NUMBER WAS ALSO PROVIDED. TRIAL TIME ESTIMATE: 2 HOURS. JUDGE: SAMUEL K. FENG; MATTER NOT REPORTED (206)
